description: A React component for rendering pivot table data with sorting, collapsing, and custom formatting features, used within a Superset plugin for pivot table visualization.

classes.name: TableRenderer
classes.description: A React component class that renders a pivot table with headers, rows, sorting, collapsing, and totals.

methods.name: getBasePivotSettings
methods.description: Extracts and prepares pivot table settings and callbacks based on props.

methods.name: clickHandler
methods.description: Creates a click event handler for table cells that triggers the configured callback with relevant data.

methods.name: clickHeaderHandler
methods.description: Creates a click event handler for header cells to handle sorting or filtering.

methods.name: collapseAttr
methods.description: Returns a function to collapse all keys at a given attribute level.

methods.name: expandAttr
methods.description: Returns a function to expand all keys at a given attribute level.

methods.name: toggleRowKey
methods.description: Returns a function to toggle collapse/expand state of a specific row key.

methods.name: toggleColKey
methods.description: Returns a function to toggle collapse/expand state of a specific column key.

methods.name: calcAttrSpans
methods.description: Calculates span sizes for attribute header cells based on visible keys.

methods.name: getAggregatedData
methods.description: Transforms flat row keys into hierarchical grouped data with aggregation values.

methods.name: sortAndCacheData
methods.description: Sorts hierarchical data and converts it into a flat array for rendering.

methods.name: sortData
methods.description: Handles column sorting with toggling direction and caching sorted results.

methods.name: renderColHeaderRow
methods.description: Renders a header row for columns at a specific attribute level.

methods.name: renderRowHeaderRow
methods.description: Renders a header row for row attributes.

methods.name: renderTableRow
methods.description: Renders a data row in the pivot table based on row key.

methods.name: renderTotalsRow
methods.description: Renders the totals row at the bottom of the table.

methods.name: visibleKeys
methods.description: Filters keys to only those visible based on collapsed state and display options.

methods.name: isDashboardEditMode
methods.description: Checks if the dashboard is in edit mode.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method assembling the pivot table with headers, rows, and totals.
